newsitem.title: UK: UK retailer Heal's plans to float - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK retailer Heal's plans to float - paper.

text.p: UK furniture retailer Heal's plans to list on the London Stock Exchange in mid-March and expects to raise about 10 million pounds from the flotation, The Times newspaper reported.

The injection of funds will be used to repay venture capital group NatWest Ventures, which helped fund Heal's management buyout in 1990, and to expand from its three stores, two in central London and one in Guildford, the paper said.
Heal's, founded in 1810, made a trading profit of 1.4 million pounds in the year to September 14, 1996 on a turnover of 19.2 million pounds.
